name: MOT_QM_RESOURCE_QUOTAS
description: Stores quotas for a particular resource.

columns.name: RESOURCE_QUOTA_ID
columns.description: Primary Key

columns.name: OBJECT_VERSION_NUMBER
columns.description: Used to implement optimistic locking. This number is incremented every time that the row is updated. The number is compared at the start and end of a transaction to detect whether another session has updated the row since it was queried.

columns.name: RESOURCE_ID
columns.description: Foreign Key to HZ_PARTIES.PARTY_ID

columns.name: GOAL_ID
columns.description: FK: MOT_QM_GOALS_B. Not null colum

columns.name: ORG_ID
columns.description: Indicates the identifier of the business unit associated to the row.

columns.name: TERRITORY_QUOTA_ID
columns.description: FK to MOT_QM_TERRITORY_QUOTAS

columns.name: RESOURCE_QUOTA
columns.description: Quota assigned by the manager.

columns.name: INCENTIVE_PLAN_ID
columns.description: Tentative

columns.name: QUOTA_TYPE_CODE
columns.description: Defaulted to REVENUE

columns.name: DEFAULT_RESOURCE_QUOTA_FLAG
columns.description: Used for the ManageSalesQuota display purpose only.

columns.name: START_DATE
columns.description: Start date for the resource quota

columns.name: END_DATE
columns.description: End date for the resource quota

columns.name: CURRENCY_CODE
columns.description: CURRENCY_CODE

columns.name: CRM_CORP_CURRENCY_CODE

columns.name: CRM_CURR_CONV_RATE_TYPE

columns.name: SEASONALITY_APPLIED_FLAG

columns.name: LAST_UPDATED_BY_PARTY_ID
